jobs.title: Global Corporate Banking, Large-cap, China, Vice President
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
As a Vice President for EPRM team of Large-Cap Segment within Global Corporate Bank, you are responsible for originating, developing and managing relationships with China headquartered companies in the sectors such as energy/renewable, power, metals/mining, EPC, manufactory etc. This division looks to promote corporate banking products and solutions, as well as investment banking products to its clients. You will also work closely with our business partners, including product specialists from Payments & Trade Services, Markets (Commodity, FX, etc.), Debt Capital Markets, Equity Capital Markets & Mergers and Acquisition, etc, to cross-sell customized banking solutions. You are expected have strong motivation and capability of driving new business origination, independent deal executions, and ability to handle senior client relationship (e.g. CFO, Treasurer levels).
Job Responsibilities
Identify, originate, pursue, execute business opportunities for a broad range of corporate banking products and services.
Manage complex, multi-product client relationships as the primary global client coverage relationship manager.
Coordinate the sales and service efforts of multiple internal business partners and stakeholders.
Proactively market clients and prospects; represent Corporate Client Banking group in the local corporate banking space and business communities, as well as develop a network of referral sources.
Collaborate with the credit risk team on credit risk tasks, structuring, negotiation, and documentation of credit requests.
Initiate and maintain strategic dialogue with clients and prospects to generate ongoing corporate banking, financial markets, payment & treasury services, and credit opportunities.
Comply with all regulatory and JP Morgan Chase's rules, policies, and procedures.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Minimum Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics or other related disciplines.
Minimum of 10 years of prior experiences in client facing roles within Corporate & Commercial Banking, Investment Banking, Financial Markets and/or Payment & Treasury Services.
Extensive and strong experience as an outstanding Client Coverage / Relationship Manager marketing and originating corporate banking products and investment banking services.
Knowledge of credit, corporate finance, payments & treasury, markets, investment banking, and other corporate banking products.
Strong leadership abilities in financial services sales and business development with solid credit, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills and self-motivated, dependable team player.
Experience and knowledge of sectors such as energy/commodity, power, renewables, EPC would be a plus
ABOUT US
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
About The Team
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.title: Tech Risk & Controls Lead, VP
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Join our team to play a pivotal role in mitigating tech risks and upholding operational excellence, driving innovation in risk management.
As a Tech Risk & Controls Lead, you will be responsible for identifying, and mitigating compliance and operational risks in line with the firm's standards. You will also provide subject matter expertise and technical guidance to technology-aligned process owners, ensuring that implemented controls are operating effectively and in compliance with regulatory, legal, and industry standards. By partnering with various stakeholders, including Product Owners, Business Control Managers, and Regulators, you will contribute to the reporting of a comprehensive view of technology risk posture and its impact on the business. Your advanced knowledge of risk management principles, practices, and theories will enable you to drive innovative solutions and effectively manage a diverse team in a dynamic and evolving risk landscape.
Job Responsibilities
Ensure effective identification, quantification, communication, and management of technology risk, focusing on root cause analysis and resolution recommendations
Develop and maintain robust relationships, becoming a trusted partner with LOB technologists, assessments teams, and data officers to facilitate cross-functional collaboration and progress toward shared goals
Leverages tools and emerging technology to lead the execution of technical risk assessments at a large scale across the Asia Pacific technology estate of ‘last mile' applications and in-country applications
Guides the evaluation of current cybersecurity principals, processes, and controls, and leads the evaluation of new technology using existing standards and frameworks
Execute reporting and governance of controls, policies, issue management, and measurements, offering senior management insights into control effectiveness and inform governance work
Proactively monitor and evaluate control effectiveness, identify gaps, and recommend enhancements to strengthen risk posture and regulatory compliance
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technology risk management, information security, or related field, emphasizing risk identification, assessment, and mitigation
Hands-on practical experience delivering enterprise level cybersecurity solutions and controls
Familiarity with risk management frameworks, industry standards, and financial industry regulatory requirements
Proficient knowledge and expertise in cybersecurity architecture, applications, data security, risk assessment & reporting, control evaluation, design, and governance, with a proven record of implementing effective risk mitigation strategies
Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level strategic decision-making and translating technology insights into business strategies for senior executives
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or similar industry-recognized risk and risk certifications are preferred

jobs.title: AMC Tech, Client Technology, Java Developer, Team lead, VP
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Seeking a Developer with extensive experience and understanding of the asset management investment business to join our Client Tech team.
Job Responsibilities
Be responsible for the architecture design, development and optimization of client facing application.
Focus on ensuring the security of the third-party supply chain (such as security of open-source libraries), conduct regular code scan (SonarQube, Snyk) and fix vulnerabilities to ensure system security.
Lead or participate in system architecture integration and upgrade, and solve complex technical problems.
Develop modules of self-developed systems, and ensure systems running safely and stably.
Be responsible for development and project management of the company's sales system, CRM, marketing platform, and product life cycle system etc.
Keep learning the new Fin-tech and introduce cutting-edge technologies to empower businesses capability.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in computer science majors, minimum 8 years of software development experience, and experience in managing complete development project independently.
Experience in asset management industry application development, such as fund sales, marketing systems, CRM, marketing integration platform, product lifecycle management system, e-commerce mobile APP, etc.
Proven track record of managing a team and coaching/developing talents
Proficient in Software development life cycle and familiar with security design specifications (such as OWASP Top 10).
Proficient in Spring family (Spring Boot/Cloud/Security, etc.), familiar with distributed architecture and microservice design.
Rich experience in DevOps and CI/CD, familiar with Jenkins/GitLab CI/CD.
Experience in large-scale system architecture upgrade or reconstruction projects, able to lead technical solution design.
Agile and sharp, fast learning ability and good communication and coordination skills.
Familiar with AI technology, experience in AI application development preferred.
Proficient with English as a working language including both written and oral.

jobs.title: Asset Management - Hong Kong Intermediary Business, Client Advisor - Vice President
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Are you ready to elevate your career in asset management? We invite you to become a vital member of our Client Advisor Team within the Hong Kong Intermediary Business. This is your opportunity to join a vibrant team in a high growth environment, where you can make a significant impact by delivering unparalleled client experiences through innovative and proactive sales strategies. Embrace the chance to grow professionally, develop your skills, and contribute to a team that values innovation and excellence.
As a Vice President Client Advisor in the Hong Kong Intermediary Business Team, you'll be at the forefront of engaging with established Retail Banks distribution clients and pioneering new ways to expand our client base. At J.P. Morgan Asset Management, we prioritize our clients, and we're seeking candidates who share our passion for excellence. Leverage our market leading investment platform, cutting-edge technology and CRM systems to identify opportunities and deliver groundbreaking solutions. We are committed to conducting 'first class business in a first-class way,' and we expect you to embody this ethos in every interaction.
If you're a self-starter with a positive attitude and a drive to develop market opportunities, we want to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of asset management and delivering exceptional client experiences.
Job Responsibilities
Build and implement client strategy to drive strategic business growth across the Retail Banks channel (Strategic Growth)
Develop and sustain strong relationships with key decision-makers, gatekeepers and bankers (Relationship Building)
Analyze industry trends and translate them into actionable business opportunities (Industry Insight)
Deliver commercial success, quality of service and risk-controls excellence of the overall business by working with internal stakeholders through day-to-day responsibilities, strategic initiatives, and projects (Leadership & Collaboration)
Collaborate to achieve overarching business objectives, including sales targets and key performance indicators (Team Success)
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Proven Expertise: Minimum of 8 years in the financial services industry with a robust track record and strong client relationships.
Positive & Growth Mindset: A go-getter attitude with the ability to bring fresh perspectives and new ideas to the team.
Product Mastery: Strong Knowledge of public and private capital markets.
Achievement Drive: Demonstrated success in a financial sales environment, with high energy and a results-oriented approach.
Relationship Management: Ability to build and manage relationships across the organization and with clients.
Integrity & Compliance: Strong fiduciary mindset with a commitment to risk control and ethical standards.
Communication Skills: Fluency in English and Cantonese is essential for effective client coverage.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills
Professional Certification: CFA designation is desirable but not a must

jobs.title: Asset Management - AI Quant Analyst - Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Focus
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Research and implement quantitative investment models using machine learning and deep learning techniques across equities, fixed income, commodities, and other asset classes.
Apply advanced AI methods, including large language models and natural language processing (NLP), to extract insights from textual data for sentiment analysis, event detection, and alternative data integration.
Conduct rigorous research to identify new alpha signals, improve existing strategies, and enhance predictive accuracy in investment decision-making.
Collaborate with portfolio managers, research analysts, and engineers to implement models in production, optimize portfolios, and manage risk exposures.
Stay current of the latest advancements in AI/ML/LLMs and their applications in investment research and management, contributing to the firm's innovation in investment strategies and capabilities.
Present research findings and model results to investment teams, senior management, and other stakeholders
Qualifications
A master's or PhD degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics, or engineering and with exposures in asset pricing, financial economics, statistical analysis, macroeconomics or econometrics, and stochastic modeling and scenario analysis (CFA or equivalent)
3+ years of experience in quantitative research or analysis within asset management, hedge funds, investment banking, or a similar financial environment.
Proven expertise in machine learning, deep learning, and AI techniques, with hands-on experience applying LLMs/NLP to financial or textual data.
Strong coding and data analysis skills are required. Python experience (additional experience in R or MATLAB, SQL, SPARK and familiarity with large financial databases).
Experience with statistical modeling, time-series analysis, back-testing frameworks, and big data tools.
Knowledge of financial markets, asset pricing, portfolio theory, and risk management.
Excellent problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to work independently as well as in a collaborative team environment.
Strong and effective communication skills (both verbal and written), especially for explaining complex quantitative concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Attainment of all necessary regulatory licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out Asset Management and other regulated activities
Preferred Skills
Experience with generative AI, diffusion models, or agentic workflows in finance.
Familiarity with alternative data sources and their integration into investment processes and strategies.
Track record of developing profitable trading signals or models using ML/LLM techniques.

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Job Responsibilities
Regulatory Intelligence & Advisory
Monitor technology regulatory and legislative developments across NFRA, PBOC, SAFE, CAC, CBA, CFETS, and SGE.
Support China LIB Compliance on technology regulatory and compliance matters.
Own and coordinate RFI responses within the Technology & Cyber domain.
Risk Assessment & Independent Challenge
Independently assess 1LOD technology risk management, controls, and governance through participation in new product rollouts, new business initiatives, and new product assessments.
Perform targeted reviews of technology processes and controls against applicable laws, rules, and regulatory requirements.
Technology Incident Oversight
Provide 2LOD guidance on technology incidents, including advice on reportability to China regulators.
Maintain working knowledge of incident thresholds, regulatory definitions, and escalation protocols within the Chinese regulatory environment.
Innovation, Automation & Operational Scaling
Use technology tools and AI-enabled automation to scale oversight and support continuous monitoring within the APAC CCOR Technology & Cyber function.
Apply AI to support risk judgment and contribute to a more data-informed risk capability across the team.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Education & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security, Business Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
Minimum 8 years of experience in Technology Risk, Cybersecurity, Compliance, IT Audit, and/or Operational Risk within financial services.
Working knowledge of China-specific technology regulations, including NFRA, PBOC, and SAFE IT requirements.
Technology & AI Fluency
Ability to understand complex technical systems, the business processes they support, and the associated risks and controls.
Familiarity with AI, large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity frameworks, and enterprise architectures.
Familiarity with emerging regulatory requirements governing AI and algorithmic systems in financial services.
Data, Analytics & Emerging Risk
Apply quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify trends, anomalies, and risk signals across complex datasets.
Experience moving from sample-based review toward thematic analysis and continuous monitoring.
Use automation and AI-assisted tools to scale oversight across the risk function.
Regulatory & Business Acumen
Translate regulatory developments from NFRA, PBOC, SAFE, CAC, and CFETS into practical compliance implications.
Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across internal stakeholders and regulatory counterparts.
Strong organizational, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of delivering results with professionalism and integrity.
Behavioral Attributes
Able to work across technology, business, legal, compliance, and operational domains, adapting communication style to each audience.
Focused on outcomes, not procedural compliance alone.
Committed to continuous learning as technology and the risk landscape evolve.
Track record of building effective relationships in complex, matrixed organizations.
Certifications (Beneficial)
Relevant certifications include CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, CCSP, or CGEIT.
Cloud practitioner credentials (AWS, Azure, or equivalent) are also valued.
Language Requirements
Bilingual fluency in English and Chinese (spoken and written) is required.

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class
As an Associate in the APAC Anti Money Laundering (AML) Investigations team, you will be a key contributor to the Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC) function and will be responsible for the identification, investigation and reporting of suspicious transactions. The AM China AML investigations team manages local AML transaction monitoring system and/or manual escalations of cases consistent with the Local regulatory and Global AML Standards, provides assessments of potential Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing as well as other nefarious activity, recommends cases for escalation and further review or closure as false positives, and is responsible for preparing and filing Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) as required. In this role, you will report directly to the AM China GFCC MLRO, and functionally report to APAC GFCC Investigation head.
Job responsibilities
Be the subject matter expert of AML and/or Terrorist Financing investigations, including comprehensive understanding of AML processes, Technology, Case Management and products/services
Manage and ensure that the quality of investigations and SAR filings adheres to the required standards, while managing SLA appropriately and timely
Assess investigations and AML trends, including partnership with regional or global stakeholders to effectively escalate, communicate, transfer information, or implement change management
Understand existing procedures and standards and assist with cross training and/or upskilling
Participate in AML Investigations or Line of Business initiatives, process improvements or enhancements, including the use of technology
Ensure timeliness and execution of any expected scope of work relating to Risk and Controls partners (e.g. Quality Assurance, Monitoring and Testing), Audit, Regulatory and/or Controls Evaluation requests are adhered to
Gather, coordinate, and participate proactively in changes to the firm's AML policies/processes or AML trends with MLROs, relevant GFCC Functions, Compliance and/or Line of Business
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, Statistical Mathematics, Data Science or related disciplines
Minimum of 3 years of experience in the Financial Services Industry
Demonstrated track-record experience and knowledge of either Investment Banking, Commercial Banking, Foreign Correspondent Bank, or Asset Management AML investigations, including proficient understanding of China AML/CFT regulations and requirements
Ability to own, deep-dive and/or investigate issues and can derive solutions independently, ultimately ensuring successful implementation or resolution
Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint etc.), and the experience to handle large volumes of quantitative data
Keen interest or experience with data analytics and visualization tools such as Alteryx and Tableau and a good understanding of programming languages such as SQL
Strong interpersonal or client management skills required to work effectively, influence and/or negotiate desired outcomes with multiple stakeholders and/or senior management
Attainment of all necessary regulatory licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out Asset Management and other regulated activities.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Ability to speak and write Chinese and Business English and requirement to handle China regulatory requirements
Experience with AML investigation system, technology driven case management tool and/or technology will be preferred
Experience with multiple differing line of businesses and/or products and services' AML investigative work and SAR filing is desirable

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class

As an Associate in the APAC Anti Money Laundering (AML) Investigations team, you will be a key contributor to the Global Financial Crimes Compliance (GFCC) function and will be responsible for the identification, investigation and reporting of suspicious transactions. The AM China AML investigations team manages local AML transaction monitoring system and/or manual escalations of cases consistent with the Local regulatory and Global AML Standards, provides assessments of potential Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing as well as other nefarious activity, recommends cases for escalation and further review or closure as false positives, and is responsible for preparing and filing Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) as required. In this role, you will report directly to the AM China GFCC MLRO, and functionally report to APAC GFCC Investigation head.

Job responsibilities

  • Be the subject matter expert of AML and/or Terrorist Financing investigations, including comprehensive understanding of AML processes, Technology, Case Management and products/services
  • Manage and ensure that the quality of investigations and SAR filings adheres to the required standards, while managing SLA appropriately and timely
  • Assess investigations and AML trends, including partnership with regional or global stakeholders to effectively escalate, communicate, transfer information, or implement change management
  • Understand existing procedures and standards and assist with cross training and/or upskilling
  • Participate in AML Investigations or Line of Business initiatives, process improvements or enhancements, including the use of technology
  • Ensure timeliness and execution of any expected scope of work relating to Risk and Controls partners (e.g. Quality Assurance, Monitoring and Testing), Audit, Regulatory and/or Controls Evaluation requests are adhered to
  • Gather, coordinate, and participate proactively in changes to the firm's AML policies/processes or AML trends with MLROs, relevant GFCC Functions, Compliance and/or Line of Business

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Economics, Statistical Mathematics, Data Science or related disciplines
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in the Financial Services Industry
  • Demonstrated track-record experience and knowledge of either Investment Banking, Commercial Banking, Foreign Correspondent Bank, or Asset Management AML investigations, including proficient understanding of China AML/CFT regulations and requirements
  • Ability to own, deep-dive and/or investigate issues and can derive solutions independently, ultimately ensuring successful implementation or resolution
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint etc.), and the experience to handle large volumes of quantitative data
  • Keen interest or experience with data analytics and visualization tools such as Alteryx and Tableau and a good understanding of programming languages such as SQL
  • Strong interpersonal or client management skills required to work effectively, influence and/or negotiate desired outcomes with multiple stakeholders and/or senior management
  • Attainment of all necessary regulatory licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out Asset Management and other regulated activities.

  • Ability to speak and write Chinese and Business English and requirement to handle China regulatory requirements
  • Experience with AML investigation system, technology driven case management tool and/or technology will be preferred
  • Experience with multiple differing line of businesses and/or products and services' AML investigative work and SAR filing is desirable

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
About the Position
As the Head of Trade & Working Capital (TWC) China and Head of Trade Product China, you will be responsible for driving the product strategy, development, maintenance and commercialization of the Supply Chain Finance (SCF) and Core Trade services that J.P. Morgan delivers to our clients out of China, reporting into the Global Core Trade Product Head as well as the APAC SCF Product Head. In addition, you will have P&L responsibility, assure proper solution sets are built across all segments, keep up to date with all market and regulatory items impacting the products, and assure day to day programs and service are managed. The role includes extensive collaboration with Sales, Operations, Service, Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance and Legal.
Responsibilities
Help define product strategy to achieve enhanced capabilities, reduce risk, increase operational efficiency, and drive increased revenue in line with the Global Strategy.
Full P&L Ownership including delivery of revenue goals, achievement of expense targets, management of cost allocations and introduction of product-specific initiatives to measure/improve product profitability.
Assess current client portfolio and identify opportunities to tweak existing business flows to grow JPM wallet share from existing client base.
Anticipate internal and external factors impacting business and implementing plans to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
Work closely with the other product managers within the group and in other regions to provide integrated solutions to our clients. Structure and present reporting and updates to senior management
Understand the risks (Tax, Legal And Compliance) inherent in the product and drive programs to reduce risk
Conduct new product development including implementing product extensions for current product offerings in light of evolving market trends, client requirements, geographic expansion and regulatory change for both FI and corporate segments, whilst managing all stakeholders
Interface with sales to provide technical product support to trade sale professionals and other sales functions. Provide regional product leadership and guidance. RFP support
Review marketing materials, sales presentations and product slip sheets against bank policies and market intelligence
Define Business Requirements and specifications including conceptual and detail design for new initiatives, in partnership with IT and Ops
Provide internal and external product advocacy through active participation at industry forums, conferences, working groups and media comms
Provide Trade Finance market updates and guidance on new regulations/directives/rules impacting
Conduct internal training sessions for multiple disciplines
Work as part of a small team with minimal day to day supervision
Experience
The candidate to demonstrate your proven product management and development experience within a Wholesale, Investment or Commercial bank
Experience of Trade Finance from either a Product, Sales, Operations or Client Service perspective. The candidate will have an understanding of the Trade Finance products including its operation, process flow and financials. This also includes strong knowledge of corporate finance, corporate credit and legal risk.
Strong work ethic and entrepreneurial spirit
The candidate to be able to demonstrate that they are a strategic thinker with the ability to motivate and drive tactical execution.
Exceptional organization, management of multiple tasks and time management skills
Able to give examples of presentation and influencing skills both with clients and internal partnerships
Experience with and/or prior collaboration with Sales, Legal and Compliance, Operations and Technology
Creative problem solver, capable of developing innovative and differentiated solutions
Strong presentation and communication skills; can sell self and ideas
Ability to proactively distribute thought expertise
Requires travel (15%)
Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

We are seeking an Associate to join our Financial Institutions Group within Global Corporate Banking. This role involves working with a high-performing team that covers some of the most important client relationships in the organization, spanning sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Broker Dealers and Leasing companies. In-depth coverage of public fund products in the market, establish and maintain fund pools, conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis on fund manager style, performance attribution, investment ability, etc., and screen high-quality underlying stocks
Assist or lead the formulation of FOF investment strategies, make tactical/strategic asset allocation recommendations based on macroeconomic and major asset classes, and construct and optimize FOF simulation portfolios

AMAC qualification obtained

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Seeking a Java Developer with extensive experience and understanding of the asset management investment business to join our Investment Technology team.
As a Development Manager in the Investment Technology team, you will be responsible for requirements research and analysis, system design, development, system go-live, changes and maintenance of the investment research platform.
Job Responsibilities
Responsible for the project management and development of the core modules of the company's investment research platform;
Promote the company's financial technology work, keep up with the development of Fin-tech, continuously absorb and introduce new technology systems, empower business, and improve the company's competitiveness
Formulate technical routes and overall framework to quickly break through technical difficulties encountered during the development process
Communicate with business users on demand and complete demand analysis, system design, coding development and project management;
Responsible for continuously tracking the progress of the project, clearly understanding and submitting the results of each stage, identifying the risks in the project, evaluating and eliminating risks, and ensuring the quality of the project;

Proficient in Software development life cycle
Proficient in Java development and micro service technology system, familiar with Spring boot, Spring cloud and other frameworks
Familiar with front-end development technologies, such as Vue, React, Bootstrap, Jquery and other open source frameworks

Strong system architecture ability, clear thinking, quick thinking, fast learning ability and communication and coordination ability

jobs.title: China LIB Infrastructure Tech Lead
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
The main purpose of this role is to lead IP(Infrastructure Platforms) in China LIB, and to support and maintain the technical infrastructure ensuring that:
the service is delivered as agreed to all Lines of Business (LoB)
all projects are managed according to plan
the operational risk environment is managed and reported appropriately
costs are managed
that there is an active program to train and develop staff for career development.
The role is a key influence across all other technology functions, ensuring that engineering and support standards are maintained. This involves communicating at every level in the organization, reporting into the location technology operating committee and other business forums as appropriate.
Responsibilities
Location:
Act as a communication point to the LOBs, Senior Management Leadership groups and represent IP to the location technology function at the LOC (Location Operating Committee).
Represent the technology function to all vendor and outside service relationships, speaking at functions representing JPMC when invited.
Perform a senior Technology advisory role to location and business leaders within the location.
Provide escalation point for technology in location.
Capture demand in location by engaging with the local business and communicate this to relevant IP areas.
Support legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements for LoBs.
Service Delivery and Projects:
Understand the service delivery profile of the location for all tower groups in IP and the Business Aligned Infrastructure groups (BAI). Ensure the service that is provided matches the requirements of all LOBs (Lines of Business) through regular reporting reviews and improvement programs.
Facilitate the infrastructure management group to ensure that communication lines are
maintained with all stakeholders, and that regular meeting structures, agreed reporting and governance are all in place and is being maintained.
Manage and facilitate the process of incident management of the location whenever service issues are discovered, reacting to all alerts as appropriate; ensure that the right level of support is available, on-call, 24x7.
Establish strong linkage with regional / global teams to leverage common processes, function and resources to manage to global service delivery targets.
Risk Management:
Understand and manage the risk profile of the location, providing updates and reporting as required. Report to the location operating committee and regional risk management when required.
Monitor and engage all risk forums for the location, ensuring adherence of the control environment and that all local towers follow respective and resultant action plans, ensure all location Managers sign off and approve their respective controls, creating evidence as necessary.
Represent the location in scope discussions escalation of issues and draft report status of all internal and external audits, in conjunction with the regional tower and BAI leads.
Represent the location technology groups in discussion with regulators, ensuring that all technology is setup appropriately under the guidelines provided by those regulators for all technology groups.
Provide overall responsibility, oversight, direction and leadership for business continuity and disaster recovery activities within location.
Financial:
Ensure that the financial aspects of the location are managed. Conduct regular reviews with all tower Managers so that the plan is correct, that expenses are being booked correctly and that any variance is explained.
Ensure that asset management processes and procedures are implemented and followed at all times.
Ensure all staff resources are in plan, and are under contract, as appropriate. Conduct regular reviews with all tower Managers to ensure location is covered.
People Management:
Ensure that a career and staff development program is in place, such that all employees have an opportunity to grow and improve in their respective roles.
Ensure regular reviews are conducted, which should include objective setting and follow up, quarter, mid and end of year appraisals. IP lead to advice towers on talent in location.
Lead and deliver at local staff forums, present global, regional and location news and updates so that staff feel engaged in the progress of the organization.
Contribute to the support network within JPMC by conducting coaching and mentoring to all levels locally and remotely.
Deliver leadership training and development to all Managers and VP's
Qualifications / Experience
Fluency in written and spoken Chinese and English
In excess of 15 years IT experience, the majority of which should be in an infrastructure role, preferably within the financial services sector.
Familiar with line of products within IP a big plus, able to lead the team and work with broad IP team ensure LIB production stability.
A strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills, communication skills. Logical thinking, details driven and well ordered.
In excess of 10 years demonstrated experience at a management level, being able to articulate proven staff development and growth success
Experienced in working in an influential role, specific experience in senior roles with no direct reporting relationships with subordinate staff would be an advantage
Experience in managing vendor and supplier relationships
Experience in working in Asia Pacific liaising and communicating at all levels across the region
Strong communicator able to create and maintain people relationships

Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Job summary
As a Debt Portfolio Manager within Asset Management, you will be a key contributor to the management of the portfolios. Your value-promotion mindset and risk-taking ability will be essential in formulating credit strategies to deliver alpha over and above our client's target. This role, based in Shanghai, will require significant coordination with fixed income research team as well as the broader Asset Management team.

Fixed income investing with focus on limiting downside risk, individual security selection and price valuation in efficiencies in the market.
Oversee for developing and implementing strategic asset allocation and optimized portfolios which outperform client defined benchmarks utilizing relative value, macro and microeconomic analysis.

Minimum 3+ years Debt investment experience with proven track record as Buy Side Portfolio Manager.

Your value-promotion mindset and risk-taking ability will be essential in formulating credit strategies to deliver alpha over and above our client's target. This role, based in Shanghai, will require significant coordination with fixed income research team as well as the broader Asset Management team.

Job Responsibilities

  • Fixed income investing with focus on limiting downside risk, individual security selection and price valuation in efficiencies in the market.
  • Oversee for developing and implementing strategic asset allocation and optimized portfolios which outperform client defined benchmarks utilizing relative value, macro and microeconomic analysis.
  • Actively participate and represent the platform's philosophy, process & strategy styles at client, consultant and internal meetings.
  • Participate in the planning and development of new business processes.
  • Provide analysis of portfolio positioning, sector allocations and key risk metrics.
  • Determine account & portfolio suitability of securities for participation in investment recommendations.
  • Study market commentary, research opinions, and economic forecasts with research analysts and assistant fund managers to assist in determining tactical investment strategy.

  • Minimum 3+ years Debt investment experience with proven track record as Buy Side Portfolio Manager.

Job Description
Job Responsibilities
Regulatory Intelligence & Advisory
Monitor technology regulatory and legislative developments across China financial regulators and government agencies, including CSRC, NFRA, PBOC, SAFE, CAC, CBA, and Exchange centers.
Support the China franchise Compliance team on technology regulatory and compliance matters.
Support lines of business through new initiative and new product assessments.
Build and maintain working relationships with lines of business, legal, data offices, and broader CCOR teams to enable cross-functional and cross-entity collaboration.
Risk Assessment & Independent Challenge
Independently assess 1LOD technology risk management, controls, and governance through reviews and other activities against applicable laws, rules, and regulatory requirements for supported China entities.
Technology Incident Oversight
Provide 2LOD guidance on technology incidents, including advice on reportability to China regulators (CSRC, NFRA, PBOC, SAFE).
Maintain working knowledge of incident thresholds, regulatory definitions, and escalation protocols within the Chinese regulatory environment.
Innovation, Automation & Operational Scaling
Use technology tools and AI-enabled automation to scale oversight and support continuous monitoring within the APAC CCOR Technology & Cyber function.
Apply AI to support risk judgment and contribute to a more data-informed risk capability across the team.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Education & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security, Business Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.
Minimum 10 years of experience in Technology Risk, Cybersecurity, Compliance, IT Audit, and/or Operational Risk within financial services.
Working knowledge of China-specific technology regulations, including CSRC, NFRA, PBOC, and SAFE IT requirements.
Technology & AI Fluency
Ability to understand complex technical systems, the business processes they support, and the associated risks and controls.
Familiarity with AI, large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity frameworks, and enterprise architectures.
Familiarity with emerging regulatory requirements governing AI and algorithmic systems in financial services.
Data, Analytics & Emerging Risk
Apply quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify trends, anomalies, and risk signals across complex datasets.
Experience moving from sample-based review toward thematic analysis and continuous monitoring.
Use automation and AI-assisted tools to scale oversight across the risk function.
Regulatory & Business Acumen
Translate regulatory developments from CSRC, NFRA, PBOC, and SAFE into practical compliance implications.
Strong organizational, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of delivering results with professionalism and integrity.
Behavioral Attributes
Able to work across technology, business, legal, compliance, and ORM functions, adapting communication style to each audience.
Focused on outcomes, not procedural compliance alone.
Committed to continuous learning as technology and the risk landscape evolve.
Track record of building effective relationships in complex, matrixed organizations.
Certifications (Beneficial)
Relevant certifications include CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, CCSP, or CGEIT.
Cloud practitioner credentials (AWS, Azure, or equivalent) are also valued.

Bilingual fluency in English and Chinese (spoken and written) is required.

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
As a Data Engineer in the AMC Tech team, you will be responsible for the uplifting of the investment data platform. You will ensure the data is accessible, reliable, and integrated to support advanced analytics and business intelligence across the investment process.
Job Responsibilities
Responsible for the project management and development of the core modules of the company's investment data platform;
Promote the company's financial technology work, keep up with the development of Fin-tech, continuously absorb and introduce new technology systems, empower business, and improve the company's competitiveness
Formulate technical routes and overall framework to quickly break through technical difficulties encountered during the development process
Communicate with business users on demand and complete demand analysis, system design, coding development and project management;
Responsible for continuously tracking the progress of the project, clearly understanding and submitting the results of each stage, identifying the risks in the project, evaluating and eliminating risks, and ensuring the quality of the project;
Assist in the development of system specifications, and be responsible for checking suppliers and self-developed codes in accordance with the specifications.

jobs.title: Asset Management - AI Systems Engineer - Associate/VP
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Inference Platform & Optimization: Build and optimize enterprise LLM serving platforms (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM) using techniques like PagedAttention, continuous batching, and quantization (AWQ/FP8) for high throughput and low latency.
GPU Pooling & AI Infra: Design GPU pooling, virtualization, and scheduling solutions on Kubernetes to maximize hardware utilization. Manage distributed training clusters and high-performance networking (RDMA/NCCL).
Model Deployment & MLOps: Streamline the CI/CD pipeline for AI models. Implement automated benchmarking, zero-downtime deployment, and comprehensive observability (TTFT, TPS, GPU metrics).
Qualifications
Education & Experience:
Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience in Backend Systems, Distributed Systems, or AI Infrastructure/MLOps, with at least 1-2 years specifically focused on LLM serving, GPU optimization, or ML Systems.
Core Engineering & Systems Skills:
Expert-level proficiency in Python and strong proficiency in Java (essential for inference engines and CUDA integration).
Deep understanding of Linux internals, networking, and distributed systems architecture.
Hands-on experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) and building custom K8s operators or controllers.
AI Infrastructure & Optimization Skills:
Deep familiarity with LLM inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI) and understanding of their underlying architectural designs. Or
Solid understanding of GPU architecture (NVIDIA Ampere/Hopper), CUDA programming, and GPU memory management. Or
Experience with distributed training frameworks (DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, Ray) and high-performance networking (RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand).
Mindset & Soft Skills:
A "hacker" mindset with a passion for squeezing every drop of performance out of hardware.
Ability to collaborate effectively with AI Researchers (to understand their models) and Backend Engineers (to integrate AI into business systems).
Preferred
Contributions to open-source AI Infra projects (e.g., vLLM, Ray, PyTorch).
Experience writing custom CUDA kernels or using Triton for operator fusion.
Financial industry (Asset Management/Quant) experience is a plus.
Language: Professional working proficiency in English to collaborate with global teams.

jobs.title: Corporate Network Engineer - Associate
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Network Services (NS),
part of Infrastructure Platforms (IP), provides connectivity for clients across the firm that all people and systems connect smoothly and securely, enabling the transport and sharing of data. Corporate Network provides best-in-class, scalable, reliable, and resilient network connectivity for data, voice, video and wireless at all corporate office locations globally.
Job Description / Responsibilities
As a Corporate Network Engineer, you will work in a team environment to provide support including:
Perform highly technical network software and hardware configurations.
Engineer, or review and approve new configurations prior to implementation, and interact with engineering and support teams during project turnover to ensure adherence to standards compliance.
Collaborate with clients, implementation, and operations personnel.
Be apprised of and recommend the implementation of new network technologies to improve stability, supportability, and performance within the network.
Interact with developers and implementers of new applications to better understand enterprise impact of new traffic streams. Continually evaluate current state of configuration to identify ways to improve service to our users and customers.
Communicate findings to performance engineering / architecture within Network Services and the LOB (Line of Business).
Creating and communicating service delivery procedures and run-books.
Provide 4th level escalation support in Severity 1 networking problems.
Perform internal formal and informal training of network support and engineering staff including Operations.
Perform duties following all JPMC standards regarding engagement, change management and escalations.
Evening/weekend work a requirement.
Qualifications / Experience
Equivalent of a B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical/Electronic Engineering.
7-10 years of experience of LAN/WAN engineering including implementing production solutions .
Extensive knowledge of class Cisco Routers and layer 2/3 Switches, load balancers, VPNs, firewalls, NAT, Spanning Tree, Multicast, MPLS, Frame Relay, QOS and TCP/IP routing including EIGRP, OSPF, BGP a must.
Experience with Cisco Native IOS and current routing/switching hardware platforms.
Knowledge of legacy protocols, RSRB, DLSW, IPX, SNA, caching, and IDS a bonus
CCIE, Written CCIE, or on the CCIE Track
Cisco IP Telephony, project management, firewall experience, technical writing is a plus.
Broadcom Proxy, F5, Arista and Juniper experience a bonus.
Trading floor, financial industry and international experience is a plus and highly desired.

jobs.title: Compliance and Operational Risk Testing Specialist - Associate
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
As a
Compliance and Operational Risk Testing Specialist
within the Testing Center of Excellence, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our compliance and operational risk management. Your expertise in test execution will be crucial in managing and conducting precise and accountable tests, ensuring alignment with the firm's highest risks. You will be responsible for assessing the control environment, identifying gaps, and driving remediation efforts to mitigate risk. Your analytical thinking and problem-solving skills will be crucial in breaking down complex business objectives into manageable tasks and activities. By collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, you will contribute to the firm's business objectives and help us maintain our commitment to excellence.

jobs.title: Relationship Partner - Deal Services - Associate
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
As a Relationship Partner within the Global Banking Deal Services team at J.P. Morgan, you will partner with industry, product, and country banking teams to support client relationship management activities and the execution of deals across debt, equity, and mergers and acquisitions.
The ideal candidate for this role is results-oriented, has a commercial mindset, is client-centric, and fosters teamwork and inclusion. You must demonstrate the ability to work across a global organization and navigate a highly matrixed environment, with a commitment to delivering excellent client experience to bankers and their clients.
Job Responsibilities
Build and maintain strong relationships with deal teams, supporting the origination and execution phases of transactions for a portfolio of clients across various sectors in APAC
Ensure timely completion of client activities and transaction milestones (e.g., client negative media coverage, ESG/sustainability related assessment, sanctions due diligence, deal announcements, and deal closure)
Join due diligence calls with deal teams to identify and coordinate necessary follow-up actions
Manage and monitor deal pipeline
Collaborate with compliance, legal, credit, research, finance and business management, and other teams on clients and transactions
Attend meetings and provide end-to-end oversight of the underwriting committee approval process
Partner with our Wholesale KYC Operations team to facilitate advisory for new and existing business, ensuring the timely and accurate completion
Identify and implement opportunities to streamline processes, alleviating administrative workloads and improving efficiency
Keep a close eye on deal controls, ensuring that all milestones are achieved on time and that any issues are promptly addressed
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Previous experience and sound knowledge of investment banking products such as Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), Equity Capital Markets (ECM), Leveraged Finance (LF), Debt Capital Markets (DCM), or Loans
Comfortable interacting with clients and senior executives, on a regular basis
Highly self-driven with the ability to work independently and take full ownership
Flexibility to juggle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to identify problems and drive effective resolutions
A proactive mindset with a track record of delivering dependable, timely, and accurate partnership to deal teams and clients
Excellent written and communication skills

A background in relationship management, sales, or deal execution is advantageous

jobs.title: Asset Management - Data Engineer - Associate
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Job Summary:
As a Data Engineer in the AMC Tech team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data infrastructure that supports our data platform, with a strong focus on fund management business logic, engineering delivery, and platform-level development. You will collaborate closely with business and technology stakeholders to ensure that our data systems are robust, scalable, and aligned with business goals.
Job Responsibilities
Responsible for the project management and development of the core modules of the company's data platform;
Promote the company's financial technology work, keep up with the development of Fin-tech, continuously absorb and introduce new technology systems, empower business, and improve the company's competitiveness
Formulate technical routes and overall framework to quickly break through technical difficulties encountered during the development process
Communicate with business users on demand and complete demand analysis, system design, coding development and project management;
Responsible for continuously tracking the progress of the project, clearly understanding and submitting the results of each stage, identifying the risks in the project, evaluating and eliminating risks, and ensuring the quality of the project;
Assist in the development of system specifications, and be responsible for checking suppliers and self-developed codes in accordance with the specifications.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Full-time bachelor degree or above in computer-related majors, with 3 years of data engineering experience and independent complete project development experience.
Proven experience in designing and developing data API interfaces.
Expert-level proficiency in SQL, with extensive experience in relational databases (e.g., Oracle) and MPP data warehouses.
Strong hands-on experience with big data technologies, including Apache Spark, Hadoop, for distributed data processing.
Experience in real-time or streaming data processing using tools such as Kafka, Flink.
Experience in designing and optimizing ETL/ELT workflows and data pipelines.
Solid understanding of data modeling principles and data architecture patterns.
Deep knowledge of fund management business logic and related data domains.

jobs.title: Asset Management China - Equity Research - Innovative Drug（创新药行业研究员）
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Job responsibilities:
Industry research and investment support: In-depth coverage of the innovative drug industry chain (including small molecules, large molecules, cell gene therapy, ADC and other cutting-edge sectors) and upstream and downstream links, responsible for sorting investment strategies and mining individual stocks in the sector, actively capturing investment opportunities brought about by key catalysis such as clinical data disclosure, medical insurance negotiation and offshore authorization, and maintaining high-frequency and efficient communication with fund managers and investment research leaders;
Fundamental in-depth research: Through solid fundamental research (including but not limited to pipeline value analysis, clinical trial data interpretation, competitive landscape analysis), identify high-quality targets with long-term growth potential, seize market opportunities through accurate timing and stock selection, and strive to achieve excess returns;
Strategy implementation and portfolio construction: Continuously deepen the ability to analyze drug regulatory policies (such as FDA/NMPA approval policies), trends in medical insurance payments and industry-leading technologies; build and dynamically maintain an industry simulation portfolio to ensure that the portfolio outperforms the benchmark index;
Complete morning meetings, weekly meetings and daily follow-up reports according to company and department rules;
Maintain your acumen on cutting-edge medical technology and business model by attending internal and external industry expert meetings, medical academic conferences (such as ASCO, ESMO, etc.) and broker strategy meetings;
Efficiently complete other related tasks assigned by the Investment Director and the Research Director.
工作职责：
行业研究与投资支持：深度覆盖创新药产业链（含小分子、大分子、细胞基因治疗、ADC等前沿赛道）及上下游关键环节，负责细分领域的投资策略梳理与个股挖掘，积极捕捉临床数据披露、医保谈判、出海授权等关键催化带来的投资机会，与基金经理、投研负责人保持高频高效沟通；
基本面深度研究：通过扎实的基本面研究（包括但不限于管线价值分析、临床试验数据解读、竞争格局研判），挖掘具备长期成长潜力的优质标的，通过精准的择时与选股把握市场机遇，力争实现超额收益；
策略落地与组合构建：持续深化对医药监管政策（如FDA/NMPA审批政策）、医保支付趋势及产业前沿技术的研判能力；构建并动态维护行业模拟组合，确保组合业绩切实超越基准指数；
根据公司和部门规章制度，完成晨会、每周会议和每日跟踪报告；
通过参加内外部行业专家会、医学学术会议（如ASCO、ESMO等）及券商策略会，保持对前沿医学技术与商业模式的敏锐度；
其他事项：高效完成投资总监及研究主管交办的其他相关工作。
Required Qualifications, Competencies And Skills
At least 3 years of equity research experience in pharmaceutical innovators;
Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail and multi-tasking skills;
Strong clinical data interpretation, expert resource integration, and the ability to select alpha companies in the industry;
Curious and eager to learn from multiple disciplines;
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work constructively and successfully with other team members;
Effective written and verbal communication skills;
Attainment of all necessary regulatory licenses (or any other licenses / qualifications as required) for carrying out Asset Management and other regulated activities.
所需的资格、能力和技能
：
至少 3 年医药创新药方向股权研究经验；
卓越的分析能力、对细节的关注和多任务能力；
较强的临床数据解读、专家资源整合、行业内阿尔法公司挑选能力；
求知欲，渴望从多个学科学习；
较强的人际交往能力，能够与其他团队成员建设性地成功合作；
有效的书面和口头沟通技巧；
已获得基金从业资格。

jobs.descriptionText:

The Centralized Research Group (CRG) is a talent hub for banking teams across the globe. It is a part of JPMorgan Banking business. Marketing materials and deal support: Work with colleagues in Shanghai and across regional locations to prepare marketing materials including market updates, pricing updates, earning summaries, case studies, peer benchmarking, target company profiles and benchmarking. Financial analysis: Analysis and interpretation of financial statements including preparing trading and transaction comparables, and financial metric benchmarking for companies. jobs.title: Global Corporate Banking - Innovation Economy-Analyst
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
JPMorgan aims to be the bank for the innovation economy. As part of Global Corporate Banking, the Innovation Economy team provides corporate banking services globally to high-growth, innovative businesses, ranging from early/growth-stage venture-backed companies to large publicly listed enterprises. We serve verticals including applied tech, biotech, climate tech, disruptive commerce, fintech, internet, software and digital assets. We are seeking an analyst based in China to join the APAC Innovation Economy (IE) team. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting senior bankers to manage and expand relationships with clients. This role requires good knowledge of the technology sector, regulatory frameworks, and emerging trends to deliver tailored banking solutions and strategic advice.
Job Responsibilities
Client Relationship Management: Work alongside Senior Bankers to onboard and maintain strong relationships with clients across the various tech verticals / sectors.
Industry Expertise: Stay abreast of technological developments and emerging trends. Provide insights on market trends, regulatory changes, and risk management.
Risk & Compliance: Collaborate with internal compliance teams to ensure adherence to policies and regulations.
Business Development: Support Senior Bankers to identify and pursue new business opportunities. Organize and network at industry events and conferences to expand the bank's presence and client base.

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or other related fields
Minimum 1 year of experience in corporate/commercial banking, investment banking, or fintech
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapt to changing client needs

jobs.title: Asset Management - FOF Portfolio Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
JOB DESCRIPTION
Be responsible for the daily investment decision-making and portfolio management of public FOF products, formulate and implement asset allocation strategies, sub-fund screening and allocation plans, and be responsible for the return, risk and drawdown control of the portfolio;
Dynamically adjust tactical asset allocation in combination with macroeconomics, policy trends and market sentiment to tap sources of excess return such as style rotation, industry track and alternative strategies;
Interfacing with institutional clients and channels, participating in product roadshows and strategy communication.
Required Qualifications, Competencies And Skills
Master's degree or above from well-known universities, finance, economics, quantitative economics, statistics, financial engineering and other related fields;
5+ years of FOF/MOM investment research experience in public funds, broker AM, insurance AM or bank WM, including at least 2+ years of experience in independently managing FOF products;
Track record of public performance and best-in-class risk-adjusted returns (e.g. Sharpe ratio, Karma ratio);
Proficient in general asset allocation theory and practice, familiar with multi-factor models, fund attribution analysis, risk budgeting, etc.
Strong market judgment, strict risk awareness, sophisticated investment logic and decision-making process;
Driven and focused, with a strong results-oriented work ethic and a strong commitment to teamwork;
AMAC qualification required.
工作职责：
负责公募FOF产品的日常投资决策与组合管理，制定并执行大类资产配置策略、子基金筛选与配置方案，对组合的收益、风险及回撤控制负责；
结合宏观经济、政策走向及市场情绪，动态调整战术资产配置，挖掘风格轮动、行业赛道、另类策略等超额收益来源；
对接机构客户及渠道，参与产品路演与策略沟通
所需的资格、能力和技能：
国内外知名院校硕士及以上学历，金融、经济、数量经济、统计、金融工程等相关专业
5年以上公募基金、券商资管、保险资管或银行理财子FOF/MOM投研经验，其中至少2年以上独立管理FOF产品经验
具备可追溯的公开业绩记录，且风险调整后收益（如夏普比率、卡玛比率）处于市场同类产品前列
精通大类资产配置理论与实战，熟悉多因子模型、基金归因分析、风险预算等工具
具备敏锐的市场判断力与严格的风控意识，有成熟的投资逻辑与决策流程
有驱动力和专注力，以及以结果为导向的强烈职业道德和对团队协作
具备基金从业资格

jobs.title: Asset Management - Middle Office Head - Vice President
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
As a Middle Office Head within the Asset Management team, you will lead the team to collaborate with internal business and tech partners, global/regional functions, and external vendors/counterparties. Your role will encompass end-to-end middle office operations, including trade settlement, cash clearing handling, front office support and vendor oversight. You will support the Front Office with Start of Day checks and Cash Management, ensuring close coordination with PMs, dealers, brokers, custodians, and service vendors for updates, issue follow-ups, and escalations. Additionally, you will lead and coordinate projects and changes to support business growth and process enhancements.
Job Responsibilities
Lead the team to perform end-to-end middle office operations including but not limited to trade settlement, cash clearing handling, front office support, asset servicing management and vendor oversight.
Collaborate with various stakeholders (portfolio managers, compliance, controls, risk, client service, operations, internal and external service providers) to design and drive comprehensive solutions that meet business requirements.
Oversee offshored and outsourced activity whilst ensuring performance and service levels are met.
Partner with internal and external teams to set up new products in internal system or with external counterparties.
Establish areas of improvement and implement new procedures and change existing process flows to ensure tight controls front to back.
Manage projects and initiatives, such as process improvement, business model changes, system implementation, new product or new market initiatives rollouts, and other ad hoc projects.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
10+ years of relevant work experience in the asset management industry or a related industry, ideally with exposure to settlement or trading support, ETF Operations and broker KYC process;
Hold AMAC qualification
High level of attention to detail and ability to resolve conflicting priorities;
Exceptional expertise in the investment market, with a strong understanding of the evolving market structure and regulatory environment;
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both internal and external stakeholders;
Ability to work in a fast-paced and hybrid environment, a “can do” attitude and the willingness to learn new applications in an ever-changing environment;
Effective written and verbal communication skills in Mandarin and English;
Knowledge of markets products (Equities/ Fixed Income/ FX/ Fund of fund/ Money Market) and associated pre/post trade operational processes with specific functional expertise in one of Middle office, settlements or asset services for equities/fixed income is highly desirable

jobs.title: Commercial and Investment Bank - KYC Client Onboarding - Analyst - Shanghai
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
The Wholesale KYC Operation (WKO) team is a global team with locations in major locations such as New York, Delaware, London, Bournemouth, Hong Kong, Singapore and China. The team owns the end to end onboarding and periodic record renewals process which involves working closely with internal stakeholders to serve as a single point. The team functions in close partnership with Sales, Operations, Credit, Legal and Compliance to ensure efficient and timely on boarding/record renewal. WKO plays a critical role in introducing new clients to our organization as well as ensuring full due diligence is done with respect to new and existing relationships. This team is responsible for the enforcement of controls associated with Know Your Client (KYC) and Anti Money Laundering (AML) regulatory requirements.
The role will consolidate the KYC profile and will ensure that all KYC and AML policies are adhered to and will be responsible for conducting reviews of client's documentation stored in internal repositories and publicly available information, initiating the necessary screening against relevant search engines and sanction lists and communicate any additional deficiencies back to the business.

jobs.title: Centralized Research Group (CRG) - Associate
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
The Centralized Research Group (CRG) is part of CIB R&A covering Banking globally. It works closely with the firm's Investment Banking (IB), Commercial Banking (CB) and Global Corporate Banking (GCB) teams offering customized financial solutions across Mergers & Acquisitions, Equity / Debt capital raising, Credit, Treasury, Cash Management, Trade, and Markets, among others.
Functional Responsibilities
The main responsibilities will include:
Industry or Product coverage: Build deep expertise and insight on industry, impact of economic / market conditions, competitive landscape, risks, trends, etc. that can be leveraged by bankers for maintaining and initiating new client relationships and generate high quality reports suggesting possible courses of action. Cover sector(s) and track developments regularly. Summarize and synthesize news updates / research reports on priority clients, regular industry reports. Work with bankers to understand clients' needs and provide appropriate product solutions
Identifying opportunities: Track a select list of priority clients and work together with the senior bankers to evaluate potential deal opportunities across the entire range of solutions and services offered
Pitching material preparation: Work with bankers to prepare marketing materials for clients including components like market and industry landscapes, treasury relationship reviews / client health checks, opportunity memos, financial analysis & benchmarking, target companies' / investors' profiles, market information, etc. Produce client-ready output which is crisp and relevant and is accompanied with well-structured presentations
Research & Financial analysis: Analysis and interpretation of financial statements including preparing comparables, modeling & valuations, working capital analysis, benchmarking, etc. Work on extensive valuations without any guidance and be comfortable with valuation techniques. Understand transaction structures and be able to determine applicability to the clients. Calculate and draw insights from a set of financial measures / models
Project Management: Comprehend projects with a high level of accuracy & display a strong end-to-end understanding of the deliverables. Engage proactively with bankers to understand client perspective and make new suggestions regarding analysis, slides or provide a new perspective. Work with senior management on various CRG-wide initiatives like hiring, training, knowledge development, etc.
Automation / Efficiency Initiatives: Identify automation opportunities to eliminate manual and recurring tasks, simplify complicated tasks and increase overall efficiency. Use basic knowledge of coding to come up and communicate ideas on transforming a business process digitally
Communication: Maintain regular value-added contact with bankers and staffers in the appropriate geography both proactively and in response to specific requests with a clear distinction between fact, informed opinion and uninformed opinion (hunch). Engage and communicate effectively with managers to keep them informed of activity in the region
Team Management: Review priorities & manage team expectations proactively; manage and monitor workload to ensure that all internal/external deadlines are met; become a mentor for the juniors in the team and help them develop the right skill sets by reviewing their work; provide clear guidance to the team to maximize efficiency
Compliance: Ensure the highest international ethical standards and regulatory compliance within the team
Essential Skills / Qualifications
At least 4 years of work experience from top Tier school / or professional qualification in Accountancy / Finance
Self-starter with excellent academic record; self-motivated, quick learner, comfortable with responsibility
Strong financial and analytical skill set; strong knowledge of corporate valuation & modelling
Good awareness of Investment Banking / Commercial Banking / Corporate Banking solutions and services is a plus
Good communication skills, adaptable to effectively partner with various stakeholders across the globe, strong at building relationships across teams
Proactive with strong attention to detail and ability to deliver output of a very high standard
Excellent organization, planning and time management skills - Able to multi task, deliver results and meet deadlines under pressure
Strong written and presentation skills with expert handling of excel & powerpoint
Good team player with an analytical bent of mind
People management experiences is required

jobs.title: Asset Management - Operations - Transfer Agent Analyst - Associate/VP
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Ready to be a key player in the world of fund management industry? As a part of Transfer Agent team, you will dive into the exciting world of fund operations, learning to cover transaction settlement and operation system maintenance that keeps our funds running seamlessly.
You will be expected to handle transaction settlement with precision, implement accurate system setup for business development and collaborate across teams to keep fund operation running like clockwork. This work matters because it's the backbone of how clients engage with our funds, building on their trust that contributes to long-term business success.
Job Responsibilities
To effectively process daily fund settlement and perform day end cash reconciliation, ensure no unexplained cash break.
Settlement account management (e.g. account opening, renewal and closure, record keeping and archive).
Setup static data in key operation systems (e.g. TA, ETF TA, Fund Settlement) to support smooth daily fund operation around the clock.
To work nightshift on TA day-end system processing (about once every week, from 9am to 11pm)
Collaborate with internal stakeholders and provide value-added operational support (e.g. regulatory data output, customized parameter table and respond to sales and client enquires)
To coordinate with stakeholders for projects related to innovative product development, system tests and process optimization according to business needs.
To communicate and resolve issues with external stakeholders such as distributors and vendors.
Duly carry out tasks according to Standard Operating Procedures and strictly observe firmwide professional conduct, proactively identify operation risks and prevent financial loss and reputational damage.
Other tasks assigned by supervisors.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Bachelor's degree or above in Business/Investment or IT related fields.
Around 8-10 years of relevant work experience in fund operation, cash settlement and clearance, holding certificate of China Asset Management Association.
Working experience on cross functional project management in large multinational company such banking group and asset management company.
Possess “can-do” attitude, excellent work ethics, be diligent and detail-oriented, have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility.
Proficient in Microsoft Office suite, including Word, Excel and Powerpoint.
Excellent communication and coordination skills, and with team-oriented spirit
Proficient in English workplace communication (IELTS score 7 or equivalent).
Quick learner and always adapt to fast changing environment, and be able to deliver results under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Overseas study and work experience is preferred.
Industry experience on managing ETFs and Mutual Recognition of Funds.
Proficiency in VBA or python coding
