jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Job Description
The Wholesale KYC Operation (WKO) team is a global team with locations in major locations such as New York, Delaware, London, Bournemouth, Hong Kong, Singapore and China. The team owns the end to end onboarding and periodic record renewals process which involves working closely with internal stakeholders to serve as a single point. The team functions in close partnership with Sales, Operations, Credit, Legal and Compliance to ensure efficient and timely on boarding/record renewal. WKO plays a critical role in introducing new clients to our organization as well as ensuring full due diligence is done with respect to new and existing relationships. This team is responsible for the enforcement of controls associated with Know Your Client (KYC) and Anti Money Laundering (AML) regulatory requirements.
The role will consolidate the KYC profile and will ensure that all KYC and AML policies are adhered to and will be responsible for conducting reviews of client's documentation stored in internal repositories and publicly available information, initiating the necessary screening against relevant search engines and sanction lists and communicate any additional deficiencies back to the business.
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the end to end onboarding process, delivering a high level of client service and relationship management.
The chosen individual will be the single point of contact for the Client during their onboarding and renewals process. They will effectively manage internal stakeholders, prioritize the pipeline through to completion, and facilitate operational performance reviews and metrics to continue to improve the client's experience with JPM.
Responsibilities
The primary responsibility is to support the day to day management of the KYC process to onboard and renew KYC records to regulatory standards with high quality and while meeting tight deadlines.
This includes manage relationships with a Front Office sub-LOB, prioritize and assign case work for the team, oversee calibration with Quality Control teams, and serve as the primary point of escalation for team members.
Identifies and communicates outstanding requirements or potential issues in a timely manner.
Review and validate documents supporting evidence to the KYC record in the system.
Liaise with team leads within country and region to facilitate knowledge sharing
Identify and execute process improvements and provide support on key process and technology initiatives
Teamwork with other supporting areas such as Legal, Compliance, Internal Controls, Technology, Client Services, as well as with other Regional and Global teams. Provide operational support to supply audit/compliance/regulatory with documentation/analysis.
Identify and apply regulatory requirements of the different applicable jurisdictions and internal procedures.
Calls and respective escalation of issues, prioritization of closures by risk and due date.
General understanding of and execute AML (Anti money laundering) policies and internal procedures, in accordance with local and global principles. Study of legal and commercial documents, in order to understand client´s activity, structure, and risk associated.
Create an effective and efficient team, through continuous communication, timely feedback, and appropriate supervisory practices.
Identify and apply regulatory requirements of the different applicable jurisdictions and internal procedures.
Qualifications
Fluent in written and spoken English and Mandarin.
University graduate with minimum 5-10 years relevant banking experience.
Sound knowledge on KYC / client onboarding, familiar with corporate and regulatory developments on AML.
Strong interpersonal skills, ability to partner with internal stakeholders, influencing and negotiating effectively with business heads and senior managers.
Outstanding client management, partnership building, and interpersonal skills to influence/negotiate desired outcomes. Able to drive team interactions with Front Office representatives in order to meet agreed priorities and deadlines.
Sense of urgency/ability to work well under pressure, different priorities and tight deadlines.

jobs.title: 2027 Commercial & Investment Bank - Markets Summer Analyst Program - Shanghai
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
If you are ambitious and eager to apply your knowledge to real-world financial scenarios, this internship offers the opportunity to work with sophisticated financial solutions across asset classes in dynamic global markets. As a Markets Intern, you will join one of two tracks - Sales or Trading - building skills and a professional network that will lay a strong foundation for your career. Our global Markets teams help clients manage risk, increase returns, and solve complex financial problems while tackling challenging business issues.
As a Markets Intern in our team, you will join one of two tracks:
Sales: Build client relationships, package tailored solutions, and help clients navigate our product offerings.
Trading: Provide liquidity, respond to market events, and manage risk across major asset classes.
You will support senior colleagues with research, analysis, and preparatory work, monitor markets, develop trade ideas, conduct portfolio reviews, and learn about our client solutions. From day one, your contributions will be valuable, and you'll receive training from expert instructors and J.P. Morgan professionals on our history, organization, and future plans, as well as technical and practical skills to help you succeed.
The program is an opportunity to take your career to the next level through hands-on experience, relevant skills training and valuable professional networking. Based on your individual achievements, those who successfully complete the program may receive offers of full-time employment.
Job Responsibilities
Support senior colleagues with research, analysis, and preparatory work
Monitor markets and develop trade ideas
Conduct portfolio reviews and learn about client solutions
Prepare and present market updates and trade recommendations
Collaborate with team members across Sales or Trading
Participate in training sessions and professional development activities
Contribute to the team's efforts in solving complex financial problems
Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills
Expected graduation date of September 2027 – July 2028 from a Bachelor's or Master's program
If pursuing a Master's Degree, it must be completed within 2 years of receiving your Bachelor's Degree
Excellent analytical, quantitative (algebra, statistics, probability), and interpretative skills
Genuine interest in financial markets and economic data and trends
Ability to multi-task and collaborate within a team environment
Strong organizational skills and ability to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment
Confidence and initiative to take on responsibility and manage your own projects
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
We're a global company whose primary business language is English and so fluency in English is required
Fluency in Mandarin is required as you will focus on client engagement and business development for the Sales desk covering the Chinese market
To be eligible for this program, you must be authorized to work in China. We do not offer any type of employment-based immigration sponsorship for this program.
Application Process
If you are advanced to the next step of the process, you'll receive an email invitation to complete a video interview, powered by HireVue. This is your opportunity to further bring your resume to life and showcase your experience for our recruiting team and hiring managers. Please complete the HireVue video interview within 30 days. Your application will not be considered for further review until both assessments are completed.
We fill our classes on a rolling basis and encourage early applications. HireVue submissions are also reviewed as they are received, up until the posting deadline. We strongly recommend that you apply and complete your assessments as soon as possible, as programs may close once all positions are filled.

2027 CHINA SEASONAL INTERNSHIP PROGRAM - PAYMENTS INTERN OPPORTUNITY
Have you ever wondered what it means to help drive innovation across global payments and are you curious how multi-national businesses manage currencies and payments? J.P. Morgan is at the forefront of innovation in emerging financial technology that is improving cash management and payment solutions. The Payments internship program offers you the opportunity to gain hands-on experience across this exciting, innovative landscape to learn what it takes to “make money move.” With the full support and resources of J.P. Morgan, you'll have what you need to succeed – from training and mentorship from senior leaders to engagement on challenging projects that use all your skills. We are looking for out-of-the box thinkers to help us drive our future client solutions.
As a Payments Intern in the 2027 China Seasonal Internship Program, you will begin a 6-month program from July to December designed to provide a realistic career experience with the firm and exposure to top professionals across functions. Over the course of the program, you will be provided the necessary training and also learn a great deal from your colleagues and teammates. You will also get opportunities to meet senior colleagues and continue building your own professional network. You will develop essential knowledge and skills, and it is an outstanding first step towards building a dynamic, long-term career with us.
The program is an opportunity to take your career to the next level through hands-on experience, relevant skills training and valuable professional networking. Based on your individual performance and achievements, you may receive an offer of full-time employment upon completion of the internship program. The full-time offer is to join the two-year Payments rotational analyst program.
As one of the world's largest banks, J.P. Morgan moves $5 trillion each day for our clients around the world— almost 20% of the global USD market— across multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector entities. Our leadership position allows us, and requires us, to constantly innovate to stay on top and deliver for our clients.
Job Responsibilities
Learn how we work with 100,000+ clients in 150+ countries to support cash management needs and technology-based payment solutions
Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies to meet client needs
Learn from product, strategy, or client coverage-based teams
Be part of creating innovative ideas to transform the Payments landscape
Work under the guidance of mentors and a supportive team
Network with industry leaders, accessing best-in-class training and learning how all our businesses work together to provide excellent customer service
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Exceptional analytical, research and project management skills
Familiarity with business fundamentals
Ability to quickly solve problems on your own and with a team
Enthusiasm, energy and a drive to succeed
A collaborative mindset and willingness to partner and work on a team
We are a global company whose primary business language is English and so fluent in English is required.
All majors are eligible to apply
Expected graduation date of December 2027 through July 2028
Be able to work for at least 3 working days per week and last for 6 months
Holding the permanent right to work in Mainland China is required
Relocation assistance for flight and accommodation will not be provided
Program Period
Early July 2027 – Late December 2027
Working Location
Shanghai / Beijing , China

December 31, 2026 (23:59 Beijing time)

2027 China Seasonal Internship Program - Asset Management– Business Analyst
What We Do
You'll work in partnership with our senior business leaders and industry experts to develop strategies that support our clients' needs..
Working here means joining a collaborative, supportive team. We want your diverse perspective to help us innovate the next wave of products and solutions for our clients. We'll give you what you need to succeed including training, mentoring, access to senior leaders and projects that engage all your skills.
What You Can Expect
As an intern in the 2027 China Seasonal Internship Program – Asset Management – Business Analyst, you will begin a 6-month program with rotation, our program kicks off with training and orientation to our businesses and you'll gain the technical and practical knowledge so you can make an impact from the start.
The program is an opportunity to take your career to the next level through hands-on experience, relevant skills training and valuable professional networking. Based on your individual performance and achievements, you may receive an offer of full-time employment upon completion of the internship program.
You will be placed in below teams for your 6 months' Internship:
Client related functions (Retail / Institutional / Digital commerce/Client Services/Market Insight): Assist with client sales and retention while gaining broad exposure to asset classes and investment professionals throughout the firm.
Marketing: We serve as the brand ambassador and voice of the firm. The team drives client engagement and business impact through delivering marketing campaigns and thought leadership contents, reaching millions of investors across both offline and digital communications channels.
CAO functions: We provide input for business planning, collaborates with colleagues, and ensures smooth business operations.
Product Strategy & Development: We are responsible for the design, development, and management of entire product range across all asset classes (equities, fixed income, ETF & Quant, liquidity, and multi-asset) and partner with investment and sales team to drive the firm's strategic growth agenda.
ESG: We partner with our global sustainable investing team to deliver ESG solution and products in China, while supporting client works, research and thought leadership initiatives on sustainable investing subjects.
About You
A strong interest in finance and asset management is essential, as are logical thinking and quantitative skills, flexibility, teamwork, excellent attention to detail, strong interpersonal skills and the ability to handle pressure and enjoy a collaborative environment. A well-rounded academic background is important. You certainly don't need a degree in Economics or Finance, but a good level of numeracy is required.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Organizational skills and project management skills
Ability to multitask and be proactive
Strong initiative, energy and confidence
Good judgment and discretion working with confidential information
Final year student with expected graduation of December 2027 through July 2028
Be able to work for at least 3 working days per week and last for 6 months from July – December 2027
Holding the permanent right to work in Mainland China is required

Job Description
2027 China Seasonal Internship Program - Asset Management – Research Analyst (all asset classes, including quantitative research)
What We Do
J.P. Morgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”) is a leading investment manager for institutions, financial intermediaries and individual investors worldwide. It offers investment management across all major asset classes including equities, fixed income, alternatives, multi-asset and money market funds.
Join this program, you will support various senior analysts in their sector coverage responsibilities as they generate high quality and actionable investment insights. The role is intended to be a development position for future senior covering analysts.
What You Can Expect
As an intern in the 2027 China Seasonal Internship Program – Asset Management – Research Analyst, you will work as an analyst from one asset class as listed below:
Equity research
: analyze stocks to help portfolio managers make better-informed investment decisions. Equity researchers employ problem-solving skills, data interpretation, and various other tools to understand and predict a given security's behavioral outlook.
Fixed Income research: Develop investment recommendations through the study of market fundamentals and technical research and maintain constant dialogue with our PMs discussing market color and research results.
AMS Research: Conduct research on investment strategies and asset allocation process through fundamental and quantitative frameworks. Analyze major asset classes, and underlying investment strategies and vehicles to help inform investment decisions.
Quantitative research: Work with large data sets to predict and test statistical market patterns and conceptualize valuation strategies, develop and continuously improve mathematical models. (Considering the differences in programming requirements, if you are applying for a quantitative research position, please specifically note your application for this direction on your attached CV)
Our program kicks off with training and orientation to our businesses and you'll gain the technical and practical knowledge so you can make an impact from the start.
The program is an opportunity to take your career to the next level through hands-on experience, relevant skills training and valuable professional networking. Based on your individual performance and achievements, you may receive an offer of full-time employment upon completion of the internship program.
More Information On Intern Role
Undertake qualitative and quantitative analysis of industries and companies in support of the research activities of senior analysts.
Forecast income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow items for near-term and normalized periods to facilitate valuation analysis.
Work closely with Analysts, Portfolio Managers and the Directors of Research to translate research insights into investment decisions.
Assist the Directors of Research with recurring and ad-hoc market and portfolio analysis, management of analyst-driven portfolios and in communication with stakeholders.
Communicate and collaborate proactively with the global network of JPMAM Analysts and Portfolio Managers.
About You
A strong interest in finance and asset management is essential, as are logical thinking and quantitative skills, flexibility, teamwork, excellent attention to detail, strong interpersonal skills and the ability to handle pressure and enjoy a collaborative environment. A well-rounded academic background is important. You certainly don't need a degree in Economics or Finance, but a good level of numeracy is required.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Organizational skills and project management skills
Ability to multitask and be proactive
Strong initiative, energy and confidence
Good judgment and discretion working with confidential information
Final year student with expected graduation of December 2027 through July 2028
Be able to work for at least 3 working days per week and last for 6 months from July – December 2027
Holding the permanent right to work in Mainland China is required
Relocation assistance for flight and accommodation will not be provided
Highly proficient in programming (Quantitative research)
But beyond that, what we're most interested in are the things that make you, you: the personal qualities, outside interests and achievements beyond academia that demonstrate the kind of person you are and the difference you could bring to the team.

Early July 2027 – Late December 2027

jobs.title: 2027 China Seasonal Internship Program - Operations
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
2027 CHINA SEASONAL INTERNSHIP PROGRAM – OPERATIONS INTERN OPPORTUNITY
Gain an unparalleled view of our leading financial organization while driving our clients' businesses forward with strategic support and end-to-end process management. The China Seasonal Internship Program is a 6-month program designed to provide a realistic career experience with the firm and exposure to top professionals across functions. Over the course of the program you will be provided the necessary training and also learn a great deal from your colleagues and teammates.
As an Operations Intern in the 2027 China Seasonal Internship Program, you will be expected to make a personal impact right from the start of the program. You will also get opportunities to meet senior colleagues and continue building your own professional network. You will develop essential knowledge and skills, and it is an outstanding first step towards building a dynamic, long term career with us. As an intern, you will gain exposure to end-to-end trade life cycle, including contracts and pricings, hedging using derivative products, storing commodities in global warehouses, physical title release and various trade settlement solutions, etc.
You will join our Corporate teams across Operations and Project Management. You will be engaged in related initiative end to end life cycle including but not limit to proof of concept, requirements, implementation and post implementation review and ensure each milestone to be delivered on time. You will be exposed with the opportunity to leverage digital tools and understand how FinTech can improve our process. You will be involving in ‘how we do business.
Job Responsibilities
Deliver cash management, trade finance, liquidity and escrow services that help clients manage their working capital and liquidity challenges efficiently.
Work alongside experienced colleagues, allowing you to understand a wide range of Cash and Trade Products.
Provide middle and back office operational support across all asset classes including equities, fixed income, currencies and commodities.
Provide all encompassing securities and derivatives processing, asset servicing, mutual fund and hedge fund administration, clearing, settlement and collateral management, vaulting and movement of physical commodities, reconciliations and billing support for clients and partners in over 100 global markets.
Support offshore physical commodities trading.
Interact closely with Sales & Trading based in Singapore and UK and Manage the relationships of Asia clients and vendors at an operational level.
Work on operational process improvement and digitalization.
Think out of box and apply strategic and commercial mind-set to resolve efficiencies.
Interact with technology and users cross border groups within the Firm to re-engineer process flows.
Facilitate regular Operations control effectiveness review, involving sample testing of process control, general control and regulatory reporting, offering challenging opportunities to deep dive of existing workflow and apply strategic and risk and control awareness to resolve deficiencies and raise suggestions on control improvements.
Interact with nearly all Operations BAU team, risk and control team, local team and APAC regional team within the Firm to understand process flows, identify gaps and work together on improvement initiatives. Even get to know how we leverage QA automated tools to identify gaps smartly.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Strong attention to detail
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Comfortable working in teams to deliver results
Highly motivated with a ‘can-do' attitude
Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment
Excel, PowerPoint and Word proficiency
Be able to work for at least 3 working days per week and last for 6 months
Minimum GPA of 3.2 out of 4
Final year student with expected graduation of December 2027 through July 2028
Fluent in English (verbal and written) is essential
Holding the permanent right to work in Mainland China is required
Relocation assistance for flight and accommodation will not be provided
Program Period
Early July 2027 – Late December 2027
Working Location
Shanghai, China
Application Deadline
December 31, 2026 (23:59 Beijing time)
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We strongly encourage you to submit your application as early as possible as programs will close once positions are filled.
What Next?
Help us learn about you by submitting a complete and thoughtful application, which includes your resume. Your application and resume is a way for us to initially get to know you, so it's important to complete all relevant application questions so we have as much information about you as possible.
After you confirm your application, we will review it to determine whether you meet certain required qualifications.
If progressed, you will receive an email invitation to complete a video interview, powered by HireVue. This is your opportunity to further bring your resume to life and showcase your experience for our recruiting team and hiring managers.
Your application will not be considered for further review until you have completed HireVue. We strongly encourage that you apply and complete all required elements as soon as possible, since programs will close as positions are filled.
Complete the online application form, attach your resume and cover letter – please indicate your preferred working location and available working days per week in your resume. Once you submit your application, you will not be able to make changes to your application information.

  • Good language skills (Chinese and English) are essential
  • Close attention to details and ability to work to very high standards
  • Capacity to work under pressure and tight deadlines
  • Pursuing a Bachelor / Masters' degree qualification with solid academic background and final year student with expected graduation of December 2027 through July 2028
  • Be able to work for at least 3 working days per week and last for 6 months

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Proficiency in Python/VBA/SQL programming will be a great plus
  • Language skills like Korean or Japanese will be a great plus

Holding the permanent right to work in Mainland China is required

Relocation assistance for flight and accommodation will not be provided

Program Period

Early July 2027 – Late December 2027

Working Location

Shanghai, China

Application Deadline

December 31, 2026 (23:59 Beijing time)

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We strongly encourage you to submit your application as early as possible as programs will close once positions are filled.

What Next?

Help us learn about you by submitting a complete and thoughtful application, which includes your resume. Your application and resume is a way for us to initially get to know you, so it's important to complete all relevant application questions so we have as much information about you as possible.

  • After you confirm your application, we will review it to determine whether you meet certain required qualifications.
  • If progressed, you will receive an email invitation to complete a video interview, powered by HireVue. This is your opportunity to further bring your resume to life and showcase your experience for our recruiting team and hiring managers.
  • Your application will not be considered for further review until you have completed HireVue. We strongly encourage that you apply and complete all required elements as soon as possible, since programs will close as positions are filled.
  • Complete the online application form, attach your resume and cover letter – please indicate your preferred working location and available working days per week in your resume. Once you submit your application, you will not be able to make changes to your application information.
